Sunny Sunday D Ride (Bicycle Club of Philadelphia)

Philadelphia, PA · Fairmount · Road

Beginner friendlyNo-drop

Sunny Sunday D Ride (Bicycle Club of Philadelphia) is a road group ride in Philadelphia, PA. It rolls every Sunday at 12:00 pm from Azalea Garden formal entrance, behind the Art Museum. About 12–24 miles, d pace, 9–12 mph. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 12:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 9–12 mph: you can talk the whole way. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Sunny Sunday D Ride (Bicycle Club of Philadelphia) group ride

A casual club ride through Fairmount Park and beyond for people new to group riding or coming back to it. Regroups as needed. Some weeks are flagged instructional and cover basics like shifting and clipless pedals. Helmet and water required; bad weather cancels.
